verdict.rationale: Cookieless tracking is a fair question for a product analytics platform, but the evidence never documents cookieless or first-party-only tracking. The consent model and session-replay consent handling are adjacent controls: they govern consent rather than removing the need for it. Server-side HTTP ingestion is a developer building block, not a documented cookieless mode, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track product usage without third-party cookies so I can minimize or avoid cookie consent banners
